Package ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.reservation.api

Datensatzklasse TimeWindow

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ch.zhaw.it.pm3.occupi.reservation.api.TimeWindow
Datensatzkomponenten:
start - the inclusive start date-time of the time window
end - the exclusive end date-time of the time window
public record TimeWindow(LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end) extends Record
Represents an immutable time window with an inclusive start time and an exclusive end time. The exclusive end prevents overlapping when chaining consecutive time windows.

Invariants:

  • Both start and end must be non-null
  • Start must be strictly before end (start < end)
  • A time window is active when: start <= current time < end

  • Konstruktordetails

    • TimeWindow

      public TimeWindow(LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Compact constructor that validates the time window parameters and enforces class invariants.

      Ensures that both start and end are non-null and that start occurs strictly before end.

      Parameter:
      start - the inclusive start date-time of the time window
      end - the exclusive end date-time of the time window
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if start is not strictly before end
      NullPointerException - if start or end is null
